newsitem.title: UK: Lonrho denies story of secret sell-offs.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho denies story of secret sell-offs.

text.p: British conglomerate Lonrho Plc on Saturday denied it had drawn up a secret list of businesses to sell after it separates its mining rump from the group's African trading interests later this year.

The Observer newspaper said the British businesses tipped for disposal included loss-making building and engineering contractor Sunley Turriff Holdings, Lloyd's insurance broker FE Wright Group and Cramlington Textiles.
"The story is nonsense. There is no secret list," a spokesman for Lonrho said by telephone.
"There are no plans for further disposals."
Lonrho announced over a year ago it would hive off its African trading operations to enable it to concentrate on its mining activities.
